description.value: Toki's Chinese Food is a Langley neighbourhood Chinese restaurant serving an extensive Cantonese-style menu spanning soups, chow mein (soft and crispy), fried rice, chop suey, seafood, beef, and chicken dishes. The restaurant offers structured family dinner packages sized for two to ten diners, as well as individual combination dinners — useful for a solo cyclist or a group refuelling together. Pickup orders are actively promoted, making it a practical stop for takeaway on a touring route through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (4115 208 St, Langley BC V3A 2H3) and phone (604-534-5346). The site explicitly promotes pickup orders ('10% DISCOUNT ON PICK UP ORDERS'), confirming takeout availability, and the menu lists multiple clearly vegetarian items (Crispy Egg Roll labelled Vegetarian, Mixed Veggies No Meat, Tofu dishes, vegetable/mushroom noodle and rice options). No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Chinese restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and pickup service — a practical food stop for touring cyclists in Langley.

Takeout.detail: Website homepage advertises '10% DISCOUNT (CASH OR DEBIT ONLY) ON PICK UP ORDERS OVER $50.00 BEFORE TAXES', confirming takeout/pickup service

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels 'Crispy Egg Roll (Vegetarian)' and lists several meatless dishes: Mixed Veggies (No Meat), Vegetable or Mushroom Chow Mein, Vegetable or Mushroom Fried Rice, Tofu Chop Suey, Salt & Pepper Tofu, and Tofu Veggies in Black Bean Sauce
